## Description

Checks whether the deposit contains ZIP files (by name or by MIME type), and whether [00_unpack_zip.sh](#help-00_unpack_zip) unpacked ZIP files found inside it (recorded in `<directory>/.zipfile_info`). Writes `generated/zip-warning[.tag].md`: a warning listing the ZIP files and the directories they created, or a "No ZIP Files Detected" note.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/05_check_zip_files.sh <directory> [tag]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory.
- `tag` - Optional suffix for the output name.
